title: Managed-unit manifest record (one canonical-JSON line per unit)
description: Machine-readable contract for governance/state/manifest.jsonl. The manifest is JSONL (one line per managed unit, canonical-JSON / key-sorted) and is the curated manifest tier of the governance data model (SPEC governance §machinery; baseline §4.1 / §4.7). It is the SINGLE source of truth for each unit's canonical location, version, default policies, and consumers list, and (ADR 0024) for each project's lifecycle maturity stage (kind=project rows). Markers (in consumer code) and observations (scanner output) reference a unit by unit_id and MUST NOT re-list consumers. Authored against governance/schema/field-ownership.md (the P2.3 SPINE-4 field-ownership record).

schema_version.description: Manifest record-shape era; lets the manifest tier evolve its columns independently under schema-on-read (baseline §4.8 #16). Initial value "1".

unit_id.description: Primary key. Kind-prefixed, dotted, lowercase-kebab identifier (baseline §4.4). Markers and observations reference this id.

kind.description: Language-agnostic unit type (baseline §4.4). kind=project registers a project/tool-granularity lifecycle record (ADR 0024): its row carries maturity and canonical_location (the project directory) and is EXEMPT from the region-unit fields (see allOf).

canonical_location.description: Repo-relative path to the canonical source of truth. powershell-helper -> reference-code/powershell/{Public,Private}/<Unit>.ps1 (SPINE-1); spec-region -> governance/spec/common.<family>.md.

canonical_version.description: Version/tag the canonical body currently carries; markers claim sync against this value.

change_policy.description: Default change policy for inlined instances of this unit (baseline §2.4).

binding_mode.description: Default binding mode for inlined instances of this unit (baseline §2.4).

consumers.description: The SINGLE source of truth for which consumers inline this unit (baseline §4.1). Markers and observations reference unit_id and never re-list consumers. Empty until consumers are wired (registration ownership #9: region units are registered in P2 for the canonical set, then consumers added in P6/P7).

path.description: Repo-relative file holding the inlined instance of this unit.

tested.description: Whether this unit's full canon test suite (ADR 0007 / P2a) has passed. Mechanical precondition for promotion to canonical_version >= 1.0.0 (ADR 0008). Initially false.

platform_scope.description: Platform applicability (ADR 0013). cross-platform: full function on all supported OSes. windows-enhanced: runs on all OSes but provides extra info on Windows, degrading gracefully elsewhere. windows-only: does not function (or is meaningless) off Windows.

ext.description: Open extension object for ad-hoc or frequently-changing curated fields, kept out of the top-level namespace so old and new records stay queryable together (schema-on-read; mirrors observation.ext, baseline §4.4).

maturity.description: Project-lifecycle maturity stage (ADR 0024; the TF.1 CNCF-aligned axis, applied at project/tool granularity only - asset-level release readiness stays SemVer per ADR 0008/0018). REQUIRED on kind=project rows; OPTIONAL elsewhere (TF.1 placement pin honored). Domain note: the third stage is 'governed' (full governance obligations in-place), an explicit ADR 0024 supersession of the TF.1 'graduated' label - graduation (separate-repo spin-out) remains a distinct physical event, orthogonal to maturity, with maturity=governed as its prerequisite.
